questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You plan to deploy a Power Pages website to handle common customer requests.  
  
You plan to use Copilot capabilities to increase site-management productivity.  
  
You need to use the Copilot features available in Power Pages design studio.  
  
Which two features should you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create an automation that triggers when a user submits data.
Create a webchat interface for site users.
Create an interface based on a short description.

questions.explanation:
Power Pages design studio Copilot can generate text copy for a text component based on a description, and it can create a new webpage from a natural-language description. These features support creating and managing site content directly in the design studio.

**Learn more:** [Add AI-generated text using Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/getting-started/add-text-copilot) · [Create an AI-generated webpage using Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/getting-started/create-page-copilot)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A large manufacturing company runs a single enterprise resource planning (ERP) application. The company uses SQL Server with an obsolete web interface that is incompatible with modern browsers.  
  
The company needs a new application interface that uses Microsoft Power Platform capabilities. Key solution requirements are:  
  
- Users must be able to read and write data.  
- Because of data-privacy concerns, all data must remain in the ERP application.  
- Costs should be minimized where possible.  
  
You need to recommend platform features that meet the requirements.  
  
Which two features should you recommend? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Power Apps supplies the modern low-code application interface for users. A SQL Server connector enables the app to retrieve, insert, update, and delete data in the existing SQL Server-backed ERP system; for on-premises SQL Server, it can use an on-premises data gateway. Connecting directly avoids replicating the data into Dataverse, preserving the requirement that ERP data remain in the ERP application and avoiding an additional data store.

**Learn more:** [SQL Server connector](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/connectors/sql/) · [Manage an on-premises data gateway in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/gateway-management)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Pages
questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Sales and a browser-based app called Sales Hub.  
  
You need to make sure that users can access Sales Hub data by using mobile devices.  
  
Which app should users install?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 for Phones is the mobile model-driven app that can open customer-engagement apps such as Sales Hub on phones and tablets, allowing users to access Sales Hub data from mobile devices. Microsoft now recommends the Dynamics 365 Sales mobile app for the best mobile experience, but Dynamics 365 for Phones is the applicable option listed.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use Dynamics 365 for phones and Dynamics 365 for tablets apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/use-sales-hub-on-dynamics-365-mobile)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
questions.question:
You are building a Power Automate flow.  
  
The flow must read every item in a Microsoft SharePoint list that describes sales opportunities and set the value of a field named Status to Overdue when the value of a field named Follow up is less than or equal to the current date.  
  
You need to choose the appropriate component to loop through the complete list.  
  
Which component should you use?
questions.explanation:
Power Automate’s **Apply to each** loop processes every item in an array, including items returned from a Microsoft SharePoint list. Apply to each is an action; a condition can evaluate the Follow up date during each iteration, but it does not perform the iteration itself.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use the Apply to each action to process a list of items periodically](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/apply-to-each)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
questions.question:
You create a Power Virtual Agents chatbot.  
  
You need to share the bot with other team members so they can try it before you share the bot with customers.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
A demo website provides a shareable prebuilt experience for teammates and stakeholders to try a chatbot during development. It is intended for testing and feedback, whereas a live production website is for customer use.\
\
**Learn more:** [Publish an agent to a live or demo website - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ie/microsoft-copilot-studio/publication-connect-bot-to-web-channels)

questions.question:
You create a Power Virtual Agents chatbot.  
  
You need to share the bot with other team members so they can try it before you share the bot with customers.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: Create a view and export the view.
Add the business process flow to a separate solution. Export the solution.
Export the form that contains the business process flow to a separate solution.

questions.explanation:
Business process flows are solution components. Adding the business process flow to a separate solution and exporting that solution creates a deployment package containing that component, which can be imported into production without exporting environment data or unrelated modifications. Microsoft Learn identifies business process flows as components that can be included in a solution and describes solutions as packages of customizations that can be exported and imported between environments.

**Learn more:** [Create a solution in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/create-solution) · [Import solutions in Power Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/import-update-export-solutions)

questions.domain: Describe the business value of Microsoft Power Platform
questions.question: What is one advantage of deploying Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 applications in the same tenant?

options.text: Use Common Data Services to connect to application data.
You only need to set up groups in Microsoft 365 for permissions to all data.
Users can access both Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 by using Single Sign-on (SSO).

questions.explanation:
A shared Microsoft Entra tenant serves as a common identity provider for Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 subscriptions. Users can therefore authenticate once and access both services through single sign-on.\
\
**Learn more:** [Subscriptions, licenses, accounts, and tenants for Microsoft's cloud offerings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/subscriptions-licenses-accounts-and-tenants-for-microsoft-cloud-offerings?view=o365-worldwide) · [Plan for deployment and administration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/plan-for-deployment-and-administration)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
questions.explanation:
Power BI template apps are purpose-built for distributing prepackaged reports and dashboards to external organizations. When a vendor installs a template app (via AppSource or a direct installation link), the app and its associated workspace are created inside the vendor's own Power BI tenant, where the vendor can connect it to their own data source and view/refresh the content independently. This satisfies the requirement that vendors consume the report within their own tenant environment, as opposed to a dashboard, mobile app, or workspace, none of which provide a mechanism for packaging and distributing content for independent installation into a separate organization's tenant.

**Learn more:** [What are Power BI template apps? - Power BI | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/connect-data/service-template-apps-overview) · [Create template apps in Power BI - Power BI | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/connect-data/service-template-apps-create)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company’s customer-facing applications must comply with Global Data Protection Regulations (GDPR) regulations.  
  
You need to recommend actions that help ensure GDPR compliance.  
  
Which two features should the company use? Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Force a user to update security questions after a specific amount of time.
Prompt a user for consent to use their personal data and record the date consented.
Block users who are identified as minors.
Automatically deactivate a user who has not used the portal in six months.

questions.explanation:
GDPR requires a lawful basis for processing personal data and requires controllers to be able to demonstrate consent when consent is the basis for processing. It also applies a storage-limitation principle, so restricting dormant accounts helps limit ongoing retention and use of personal data. Blanket blocking of minors and periodic security-question changes are not general GDPR requirements.

**Learn more:** [Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32016R0679)

questions.question:
A company uses a model-driven app to capture customers’ dietary preferences.  
  
You need to reorder the columns in a personal view that you created for the Contact table.  
  
Where should you change the column order?
questions.explanation:
Personal views are created and managed by users in a model-driven app. On the grid page, **Edit columns** allows the user to remove, add, or reorder the columns in that personal view.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage personal views on a grid page](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/user/grid-filters-advanced)

questions.question:
A company wants its users to begin using Power Automate to improve their personal productivity.  
  
You need to create a flow.  
  
Which two elements must be included? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A Power Automate cloud flow must contain a trigger, which initiates the flow, and at least one action, which performs the work after the trigger occurs. Conditions and expressions are optional flow logic features.\
\
**Learn more:** [Work with triggers and actions - Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/work-with-triggers-actions)

questions.question:

You need to create a flow.  
  
Which two elements must be included? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Ask the outside source to send you the data once a week.
Use Power Automate to connect to the database.
Open a ticket with Microsoft and request a new connector.

questions.explanation:
A custom connector lets Power Apps connect to an external service or API when no suitable built-in connector is available. It provides the required integration without depending on a specific database, manual data transfer, or Microsoft creating a new connector.

**Learn more:** [Share a custom connector in your organization](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/connectors/custom-connectors/share) · [Use custom connectors in a Power Apps canvas app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/use-custom-connectors-in-powerapps-canvas-app/)

questions.domain: Describe the business value of Microsoft Power Platform
questions.question:
You use Power Automate to create a flow that automatically sends an email to a project manager when project team members mark a task as complete.  
  
Project team members are marking tasks as complete prematurely. Project leads must validate that tasks are complete before an email is sent to the project manager to announce task completion.  
  
You need to modify the flow.  
  
Which component should you use?
questions.explanation:
A Power Automate **Condition** evaluates the project lead’s validation status and routes execution accordingly. The email action can be placed in the true branch so it runs only after the task has been validated.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add a condition to a cloud flow in Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/add-condition)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],User1 creates several Power BI dashboards for a company. User1 shares a dashboard with User2, who works for another company. User2 reports that she can view the dashboard. User2 forwards the email containing the dashboard-sharing link that she received to User3.  
  
User3 reports that he gets an error message when he selects the link to view the dashboard. User3 can view a dashboard that he created.  
  
You need to determine why User3 receives an error.  
  
What is the issue?

options.text: User3 is running an out-of-date version of Power BI and must upgrade to a newer version.
User2 is signed in to the dashboard and must sign out before User3 can sign in.
Forwarding the email does not share the dashboard with User3.
User1 is signed in using the wrong organizational account for Power BI.

questions.explanation:
Power BI grants dashboard access to the direct recipient specified by the owner. Forwarding a sharing email or its link does not grant the forwarded recipient permission to view the dashboard; User3 must be granted access directly.

**Learn more:** [Collaborate and share Power BI reports and dashboards](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/collaborate-share/service-share-dashboards)

a public website that supports multilingual communities with forums and blogs support
a secure website for mobile users that is available only by using a VPN into the corporate network
a secure website for vendors accessing data stored in Common Data Service
an internal website for employees with limited access to Dynamics 365 Finance data

Its capabilities include customer self-service knowledge bases and document uploads, multilingual community sites with forums and blogs, and secure vendor access to Common Data Service records.

You are working with Dynamics 365 Sales.  
  
You need to bring data into a Power BI report for your team. The City and State columns must be combined into a single column in the report.  
  
Which function should you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Use Power Query to merge columns.

questions.explanation:
Power Query can combine two existing columns, such as City and State, into a new single column for use in the report. The `Table.CombineColumns` operation combines specified columns using a chosen combiner function.\

questions.question:
A company intends to implement a ticketing application by using Microsoft Dataverse.  
  
The company plans to deploy a portal connected to the ticketing application. Customers must be able to sign in and view details of open cases.  
  
You need to identify the Microsoft Power Platform capability that provides the required functionality.  
  
Which solution should be used?
questions.explanation:
Power Pages provides external-facing websites that let customers sign in and securely view data stored in Microsoft Dataverse, including case details.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Power Pages documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/) · [Overview of authentication in Power Pages](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/authentication/)

The company plans to deploy a portal connected to the ticketing application. Customers must be able to sign in and view details of open cases.  
  
You need to identify the Microsoft Power Platform capability that provides the required functionality.  
  
Which solution should be used?
questions.explanation:
An on-premises data gateway securely bridges a Power Apps canvas app to data sources that are not in the cloud, enabling the app to retrieve on-premises data. Microsoft states that a canvas app connecting to an on-premises data source requires an on-premises data gateway.

**Learn more:** [Manage an on-premises data gateway in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/gateway-management) · [Understand canvas app execution phases and data call flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/execution-phases-data-flow)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company constructs and sells residential apartments. It uses Dynamics 365 Sales to manage sales opportunities.  
  
Management must be notified on mobile devices whenever sales opportunities are created.  
  
You need to recommend the appropriate Microsoft Power Platform components to meet these requirements.  
  
Which two components should you recommend to invoke the notification process? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A Power Automate cloud flow can run the notification process, and the Microsoft Dataverse connector provides a trigger that starts a flow when a row is created in a Dataverse table. Dynamics 365 Sales opportunity records are therefore able to trigger the flow through that connector.

**Learn more:** [Overview of how to integrate flows with Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/dataverse/overview) · [Microsoft Dataverse connector reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/connectors/commondataserviceforapps/)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
questions.question:
You are new to working with Microsoft Flow. You create a flow that extracts users’ birth dates and then sends them a birthday greeting email on their birthday.  
  
The flow does not correctly extract the birth dates. Where should you make changes?
questions.explanation:
Expressions contain the data-processing logic in a flow, including extracting, parsing, and formatting date values. The birth-date extraction logic should therefore be corrected in the expression.\
\
**Learn more:** [Expression cookbook for cloud flows](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/expression-cookbook)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Pages
questions.question:
You are building a canvas app that lets staff members order and collect items from a warehouse.  
  
The app needs a control to display pictures without customization.  
  
You need to add the control.  
  
Which type of control should you use?
questions.explanation:
A Gallery control displays a set of data records and provides predefined layouts for showing images and text. It is suitable for presenting warehouse-item pictures without building a custom display, whereas list boxes and combo boxes are selection controls.\
\
**Learn more:** [Gallery control in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/control-gallery)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses a Power Apps canvas app to enter information. The canvas app uses a Microsoft SharePoint list to store that information.  
  
A user manually copies the information into a Microsoft Dataverse instance.  
  
You must automate this manual process.  
  
You need to create a solution that meets the requirement.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) control for the OnLoad events.
Create a business process flow that calls a Power Automate desktop flow.
Create a Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) control for the OnSave event.
Create a Power Automate cloud flow with no connectors.
Create a Power Automate cloud flow with a connector to email.

questions.explanation:
Power Automate desktop flows provide robotic process automation for repetitive, rule-based user tasks. They support SharePoint and Microsoft Dataverse connector actions, including creating Dataverse rows, so they can automate the transfer that a user currently performs. A business process flow can invoke automation as part of the process.

**Learn more:** [Cloud connectors in Power Automate for desktop](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/desktop-flows/actions-reference/cloudconnectors) · [Create instant flows in business process flows](https://learn.microsoft.com/lb-lu/power-automate/create-instant-flows)

options.text: Create a Power BI workspace and grant coworkers permissions.
Publish the dashboard as an app to your coworkers.
Export the data into Common Data Service for others to manipulate in Power BI.
Export the data to Microsoft Excel for coworkers to import and view in Power BI.
Embed reports in your company's internal web portal.

You are building a report in the Power BI service by using a dataset.  
  
You need to add a visual.  
  
Which two methods can you use to add the visual? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Drag a field onto the canvas.
Pin a page from another report.
Pin a visual from another report.

questions.explanation:
A report visual can be added by selecting a visual type in the Visualizations pane and then supplying fields. Dragging a field onto the report canvas also creates a visual automatically, with Power BI choosing an appropriate visual type from the field data. Pinning content creates dashboard tiles, not visuals in a report.

**Learn more:** [Overview of Power BI reports](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/create-reports/power-bi-reports-overview) · [Add Visualizations to a Power BI Report](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ca/power-bi/visuals/power-bi-report-add-visualizations)

questions.question:
A company has a Power Apps app used by most employees. The company is expanding into additional countries/regions.  
  
You need to recommend a solution for translating text generated in the Power Apps app in near real time.  
  
What should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Azure Cognitive Services provides the Translator text service, whose API performs neural machine translation of source text to target languages in real time, making it suitable for multilingual text generated within an app.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Azure Text translation in Foundry Tools?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/translator/text-translation/overview)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
questions.question:
A company uses Dataverse to store information about the products it sells.  
  
The company needs an interface that enables unauthenticated external users to browse product information from a mobile device.  
  
You need to recommend the Microsoft Power Platform component the company should use to create the interface.  
  
Which component should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Power Pages creates external-facing websites that work across browsers and devices and can use data stored in Dataverse. It is therefore the appropriate component for a public, mobile-accessible product-browsing interface.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Power Pages?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/introduction)

The company needs an interface for back-office staff. The solution must meet these requirements:  
  
- Existing custom tables must be displayed in the interface.  
- The user experience must be similar to the existing Dynamics 365 Sales app.  
- Users must be able to edit existing data or create new data.  
  
You need to recommend a Power Platform capability that meets these requirements with the least configuration effort.  
  
Which capability should you recommend?

You build a model-driven app for a department.  
  
You must make the model-driven app available to other members of that department.  
  
Which two methods should you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Send the application's Web URL to other team members by email.
Use the Share feature in the Power Apps designer.
Deploy the application to other user's instances through PowerShell.

questions.explanation:
Model-driven apps are shared through the Power Apps **Share** experience, which assigns people, teams, or security roles access to the app. Users can also be given the app’s web link—for example, by email—so they can open it; they must have the required security-role access. Publishing to AppSource and deploying to other environments are not methods for sharing an app with department members. [Microsoft Learn: Share a model-driven app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/share-model-driven-app)

**Learn more:** [Share a model-driven app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/share-model-driven-app)

questions.question:
A company has created a Power Apps app to photograph and store business-card data during a seminar.  
  
The company needs to choose a tool that can extract data from those pictures.  
  
You need to identify the tool.  
  
Which tool should you choose?
questions.explanation:
AI Builder includes a prebuilt Business Card Reader component for Power Apps that can take or load business-card images and extract their information.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use the business card reader component in a canvas app in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ai-builder/business-card-reader-component-in-powerapps)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A hotel creates a housekeeping checklist for its housekeeping staff to use after they complete the cleaning of a room.  
  
The housekeeping staff must be able to use their mobile devices to add a check mark for every completed task and take a photo of the prepared bed.  
  
The checklist results for each room must be stored in a SharePoint list.  
  
You need to select the Microsoft Power Platform component that meets the requirement.  
  
Which component should you select?
questions.explanation:
A canvas app supports a tailored mobile data-entry experience, including check marks and device-camera photo capture. It can connect directly to a SharePoint list so each room’s completed checklist data is stored in that list.

**Learn more:** [Create a canvas app with data from a list](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ca/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/app-from-sharepoint) · [Add picture control in canvas apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/control-add-picture)

You need to update the business rule.  
  
What are two ways to achieve the goal? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.

options.text: Save a copy of the rule and change the condition. Deactivate and delete the original rule.
Deactivate the business rule and change the condition.
Take a snapshot of the business rule and change the condition.

questions.explanation:

**Learn more:** [Create a business rule in Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/data-platform-create-business-rule)

You have been added to a dashboard in a workspace.  
  
You need to determine where you can view the dashboard.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Power Apps canvas apps.  
  
When a user opens Power Apps Studio in a browser and selects **Apps I can edit**, they cannot see an app that they need to modify.  
  
You need to identify why the user is unable to view the app.  
  
What are three possible reasons? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: The user selected an incorrect Power Apps environment.
The user has not been granted the System Customizer role.
The user has not been set as the app co-owner.
The app has not been shared with the user.
The environment does not have a Microsoft Dataverse database.

questions.explanation:
Canvas apps are environment-specific, so an app is not displayed when the wrong Power Apps environment is selected. A user can edit a canvas app only when they own it or have Co-owner permission. If the app has not been shared with the user at all, the user has no access to it; if it is shared only for use rather than as a co-owner, it is not available for editing.

**Learn more:** [Edit a canvas app - Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/edit-app) · [Share a canvas app with your organization - Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/share-app)

questions.question:
An enterprise organization is evaluating the Microsoft Power Platform security model.  
  
You need to determine the lowest possible level at which authorization can be applied.  
  
Which level should you identify?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Power Platform, through Dataverse, supports column-level security that controls access to data in individual columns, including whether users can view or set a column value. This is more granular than tenant-, environment-, or row-level authorization.\
\
**Learn more:** [Column-level security to control access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/field-level-security) · [Security in Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/wp-security)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Pages
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft Excel workbook that holds a list of tasks for a project. You save the file in OneDrive for Business.  
  
You need to create a canvas app that enables team members to update the status of their tasks.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: the Generate an app from data feature
a custom action in Common Data Service
the Open entity data in Excel feature

questions.explanation:
Power Apps can generate a canvas app from Excel data stored in cloud storage such as OneDrive for Business. The generated app connects to the workbook’s table data and supports editing records, including task-status values.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a canvas app based on Excel data](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/get-started-create-from-blank) · [Overview of connectors for canvas apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/connections-list)

questions.domain: Describe the business value of Microsoft Power Platform
questions.question:
A company uses a model-driven app.  
  
You add several columns to a form.  
  
Users report that the new columns do not appear on the form.  
  
You need to resolve the issue.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Ensure columns are in one section of the form only.
Copy the form and rename it.

questions.explanation:
Model-driven app form changes must be published before they are available to app users. Publishing the form makes the newly added columns visible.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add, configure, move, or delete columns on a form](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/add-move-or-delete-fields-on-form)

questions.question:
A company intends to implement customer engagement apps in Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
The company intends to deploy a portal connected to Customer Service. Customers must be able to sign in and view details of open cases.  
  
You need to identify the Microsoft Power Platform capability that delivers the required functionality.  
  
Which solution should you use?
questions.explanation:
Power Pages provides external-facing sites where customers can authenticate and access Dataverse data, including Customer Service cases. Its case-management capabilities allow customers to view and update their own case information.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage cases in Power Pages](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/templates/dynamics-365-apps/case-management) · [Overview of authentication in Power Pages](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/authentication/)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Microsoft 365 and has no developers on staff.  
  
You need to describe to the executives the benefits of using Power Platform apps.  
  
Which two benefits apply? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> **Note:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Users can use Power Apps to create apps for different departments.
Users can send emails from Microsoft 365 to their personal email addresses.
The company can unify all the mobile devices to one vendor.
Users can use Power Automate to extract information from Microsoft 365 services.

questions.explanation:

You are building a Dataverse data model for an event-planning company.  
  
Individuals can register for multiple events during a cycle. When event planners create an event, information about the individuals must automatically copy to the new event. Organizations must be prevented from registering. You create the table for the events.  
  
You need to determine which Dataverse component to use to complete the model.  
  
Which component should you identify?
questions.explanation:
A Dataverse relationship models the association between individual contact records and event records, allowing one individual to be associated with multiple events. For a 1:N or N:1 relationship, column mappings can copy values from the primary record to a newly created related record. Using a relationship to the Contact table also avoids the Customer column’s ability to reference Account records, which represent organizations.

**Learn more:** [Map table columns in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/map-entity-fields) · [Customer tables (account, contact, and customeraddress)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/customer-entities-account-contact)

questions.domain: Manage the Microsoft Power Platform environment
questions.question:
A Power Automate flow is overwritten when you edit its definition and save the changes.  
  
You need to be able to revert a flow to its current state.  
  
Which two options can you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Exporting preserves the flow definition in a package that can subsequently be imported with the Update option to restore that definition. Save As creates a separate copy of the flow, preserving the current version for later use. Renaming or sharing does not create a restorable copy of the definition.\
\
**Learn more:** [Export and import a non-solution flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/export-import-flow-non-solution) · [Edit a solution-aware cloud flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ca/power-automate/edit-solution-aware-flow)

questions.domain: Describe the business value of Microsoft Power Platform
questions.question:
A canvas app was recently updated, and the update has caused usability problems.  
  
You need to revert the app to an earlier version.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Restore the previous version of the app.
Uninstall the app for all users and reinstall by using the package from a previous version.
Deactivate the live app, import the previous version of the app, and then activate the app.
Delete the app and create a new app based on the previous version.

questions.explanation:
Canvas apps support version history, allowing an earlier saved version to be restored. The restored version can then be published if it must become the live version for users.\
\
**Learn more:** [Restore your canvas app to a previous version](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/restore-an-app)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
questions.question:
A company keeps its customer warranty information in Microsoft Dataverse.  
  
Authenticated and authorized customers must be able to access their own warranty information without needing a user-assigned Microsoft Power Platform license.  
  
You need to share the warranty information with these customers.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Power Pages provides an external-facing, authenticated website for Dataverse data. Site users are represented by contact records and can be granted access to only their own records through web roles and table permissions, without being licensed as individual Power Platform users.\
\
**Learn more:** [Power Pages connectivity to Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/admin/connectivity) · [Power Pages security](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/power-pages-security)

The solution must identify the caller's location and translate all information supplied by the caller from the caller's native language into English.  
  
Which two components should you use? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Remote Assist for mobile

questions.explanation:
Power Virtual Agents provides the self-service conversational interface for customer interactions. Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services includes Azure Translator, which can automatically detect a source language and translate the supplied text to English; it therefore supplies the required language-processing capability.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are developing a canvas app that lets users order tickets. You add an input field in which users enter the number of tickets to order.  
  
Users must order at least two tickets and no more than four tickets. If a user enters any number other than 2, 3, or 4, the input field must appear red. If a user enters 2, 3, or 4, the input field must appear green.  
  
You need to set the input field color according to the user’s input.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
A Power Fx formula can be assigned to a text-input color property and use conditional logic, such as `If`, to return green when the entered value is 2, 3, or 4 and red for any other value. Canvas-app formulas recalculate automatically as referenced input values change.

**Learn more:** [Understand behavior formulas for canvas apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/working-with-formulas-in-depth)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
questions.question:
You use the Power BI service to view a visual in a report that was shared with you.  
  
You need to add that visual to a dashboard as a tile.  
  
Which action should you take?
questions.explanation:
In the Power BI service, a dashboard tile is created from a report visual by using **Pin** (or **Pin visual**). Exporting, copying, and spotlighting a visual do not add it to a dashboard.\
\
**Learn more:** [Introduction to dashboard tiles for Power BI designers](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/create-reports/service-dashboard-tiles)

questions.question:
You are building a Power Pages website for a company.  
  
You create the site pages and apply branding. You must now make the site visible on the internet.  
  
You need to choose the tool to use to make the site available.  
  
Which tool should you use?
questions.explanation:
The Power Pages Design studio is used to configure a site for go-live and set its visibility to Public, allowing anyone on the internet to access it. Power Pages sites are private by default; changing the site visibility to Public makes the site externally available.\
\
**Learn more:** [Site visibility in Power Pages](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/site-visibility) · [Overview of designing and building sites](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/configure/editing-sites)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
questions.question:

You create the site pages and apply branding. You must now make the site visible on the internet.  
  
You need to choose the tool to use to make the site available.  
  
Which tool should you use?
questions.explanation:
Copilot in Power Apps lets makers describe business requirements in natural language and generates an app together with its Dataverse data model. It is therefore suitable for creating a stock-item tracking solution when no existing data source or image is available.

**Learn more:** [Build apps through conversation with Copilot - Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/ai-conversations-create-app) · [Overview of creating apps in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/)

questions.domain: Describe the business value of Microsoft Power Platform
questions.question:
You create a canvas app by selecting **Start from data** and connect a spreadsheet containing customer records. The customer records appear in a list on a screen labeled **Browse**.  
  
You need to apply a filter to the control that displays the customer records.  
  
Which control should you modify?
questions.explanation: A gallery control displays the record list on a Browse screen in a canvas app. Its Items property determines which customer records are shown, so applying a filter requires modifying the gallery.

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
questions.question:
A company is evaluating whether to use Power Pages for its website.  
  
You need to establish whether the Power Pages use cases satisfy the company’s requirements.  
  
Which of the following is a use case for Power Pages?
questions.explanation:
Power Pages creates secure, external-facing, data-driven business websites that can extend Dataverse data to customers, partners, and employees. Sharing data with customers is therefore a Power Pages use case.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Power Pages?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/introduction) · [Core components of Power Pages](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/power-pages-intro/)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
questions.question:
A company uses a Power Pages site to let prospective customers book appointments.  
  
You use Copilot to generate a paragraph for the About us page.  
  
You need to revise the paragraph.  
  
Which three actions should you take to edit the text using Copilot? Each correct answer presents a complete solution. (Choose three.)  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Power Pages Copilot can refine generated text by rewriting it to produce a new version, changing its tone to professional, and adjusting its length. These are supported refinements for generated text in the Power Pages text component.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add AI-generated text using Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/getting-started/add-text-copilot)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Pages
questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
You need to use Power Automate to automate the receipt and tracking of raw materials.  
  
Which connector type should you use?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management is a finance and operations application. The Finance and Operations connector for Power Automate provides access to finance and operations data entities and supports integration through triggers and actions, making it the appropriate connector for automating raw-material receiving and tracking.\
\
**Learn more:** [Fin & Ops Apps (Dynamics 365) connector](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/connectors/dynamicsax/) · [Application Connector - Finance & Operations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/data-entities/fin-ops-connector)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company wants to create customer user interfaces that provide additional functionality.  
  
You need to recommend a solution for the company.  
  
What should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Power Apps canvas apps enable tailored, low-code business user interfaces that can connect to data and other services. They are appropriate for adding customer-facing functionality, whereas Power BI provides analytics, AI Builder provides AI capabilities, and Microsoft Flow/Power Automate provides workflow automation.\
\
**Learn more:** [Start building apps - Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/) · [Customer portal for Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/customer-portal-overview)

questions.question:
A company uses Power BI and wants to identify which data connectors are available to build dashboards.  
  
You need to assess the available connectors. What should you use to view all available connectors?
questions.explanation:
Power BI Desktop provides the Get Data dialog, including an All category, to view the available data connectors for connecting data used in reports and dashboards.\
\
**Learn more:** [Data sources in Power BI Desktop](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/connect-data/desktop-data-sources)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
questions.question:
A retailer plans to build a canvas app for employees. The app can run on tablets, and it uses a custom authentication system.  
  
The company wants employees to be automatically signed out of the canvas app after five minutes if they use another application on the tablet.  
  
You need to identify the control that triggers this action.  
  
Which control should you choose?
questions.explanation:
A Timer control can run for a configured duration of 300,000 milliseconds and use its `OnTimerEnd` property to run the custom sign-out action. Power Apps defines `OnTimerEnd` as the action performed when a timer finishes running.\
\
**Learn more:** [Timer control in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/control-timer)

questions.question:
A company develops a Power Apps application named Inventory Management.  
  
Users report problems accessing the app.  
  
You need to create a Microsoft support ticket.  
  
Where should you create the support ticket?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft support requests for Power Platform products, including Power Apps, are created through the Support experience in the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.\

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are deploying Power Apps for a company.  
  
Data from an online proprietary accounting system must be automatically updated in Microsoft Dataverse every four hours without creating duplicates. Only data changes must be added, and thousands of records are added each hour.  
  
You need to configure the technology to ensure the data is integrated every four hours.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a Cloud flow that exports and imports the data.
Export all data to Azure Blob storage.

questions.explanation:
The defining requirements are a repeating four-hour schedule, importing only changed records into Dataverse, and avoiding duplicates at high volume. A scheduled Power Automate cloud flow satisfies all of this: it can be set to recur every four hours, query the accounting system for changed records, and upsert them into Dataverse so no duplicates are created. A custom connector alone only exposes the API - it does not schedule, deduplicate, or move data on its own - and exporting to Azure Blob storage never lands the data in Dataverse at all.

**Learn more:** [Run a cloud flow on a schedule](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/run-scheduled-tasks)

Which three benefits should you describe? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.

options.text: Data schema changes can be made without any knowledge of code.
Existing Dynamics 365 customer engagement apps integrate natively with Dataverse.

questions.explanation:

Dataverse is also an extensible platform with supported Azure integration, including Azure-aware plug-ins and Azure Service Bus.

A company is undertaking a digital transformation by using Microsoft Power Platform.  
  
The company’s departments have the following requirements:  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783844531492-l88ivqbh.png)  
  
You need to identify which department can use a canvas app to satisfy its requirement.  
  
For which department should you develop a canvas app?
questions.explanation:
A canvas app is well suited to the Facilities requirement because it can provide technicians with a custom mobile data-entry experience, use the device camera to capture equipment photos, and save the photos and recorded condition details to a data source. Microsoft documents that canvas apps run on mobile devices and that the Camera control captures pictures using a device camera.

**Learn more:** [What are canvas apps?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/getting-started) · [Camera control in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/control-camera)

You must ensure that users cannot share customer data with other users. You must also ensure that users cannot connect to data sources unless you explicitly grant them permission to access a data source.  
  
You need to recommend solutions that meet the company's security requirements.  
  
Which two types of policies should you recommend? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

questions.explanation:
Power Platform data policies (DLP policies) help prevent exposure of organizational data by controlling enabled connectors and which connectors may be used together. lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 Sales, and it has no developers on staff.  
  
You need to describe to the executives the advantages of using Power Platform apps.  
  
What are two benefits? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Users can send emails from Dynamics 365 Sales to their personal email addresses.
Users can create Power Apps to create apps for different departments.
Users can use Power Automate to share information between Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 Sales.
The company can unify all the mobile devices to one vendor.

questions.explanation:
Power Apps enables users to create custom business apps without writing code, allowing departments to address their own app needs. Power Automate creates automated processes across services and can run flows from Dynamics 365 Sales, enabling information sharing and workflow automation between Microsoft 365 services and Dynamics 365 Sales.

**Learn more:** [What is Power Apps?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/powerapps-overview) · [Enable Power Automate integration to automate processes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/enable-embedded-flow-in-your-organization)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A colleague creates an automated cloud flow and shares it with you.  
  
The flow begins when a new account record is added to a model-driven app. It then sends an approval to the company director in Microsoft Teams. After the director approves it, the flow updates the account record status to active and sends a templated welcome email to the new account.  
  
You need to identify the connector that supplies the trigger for this flow.  
  
Which connector should you select?
questions.explanation:
Account records in a model-driven app are Microsoft Dataverse table rows. The Microsoft Dataverse connector provides the trigger that starts a cloud flow when a row is added, modified, or deleted; the approval, Teams, and email operations occur after that trigger.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Dataverse connector](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/connectors/commondataserviceforapps/) · [Overview of how to integrate flows with Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/dataverse/overview)

questions.domain: Describe the business value of Microsoft Power Platform
questions.question:
You must implement Microsoft Business Applications together with the Microsoft Power Platform.  
  
Which three Microsoft products are included in the Power Platform? Each correct answer represents a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Power Platform includes Power Apps for building applications, Power Automate for automating workflows, and Power BI for analyzing and visualizing data. Azure Active Directory and Azure Machine Learning are Azure services, not Power Platform products.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Power Platform documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
questions.question:
A carpet-cleaning company uses Dynamics 365 Sales.  
  
The process of entering customer information during onsite sales calls is very complex. The company wants a simplified screen that lets salespeople record the customer name, phone number, and other information while talking with the customer.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that works across different types of mobile devices. What should you recommend?
questions.explanation: A canvas app provides a custom, streamlined data-entry interface and runs on various mobile devices. It can be tailored to capture the required customer details and connect to Dynamics 365 Sales data.

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management together with Dynamics 365 Finance.  
  
User-account data must synchronize between the two systems. You need to make sure the synchronized data is kept in a single location.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Finance and Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management use Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) as the primary identity provider. Storing identities in the shared tenant centralizes user-account data and supports access across both finance and operations applications.\
\
**Learn more:** [Secure finance and operations apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/guidance/implementation-guide/security-strategy-product-oa) · [Create new users - Finance & Operations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/fin-ops/sysadmin/create-new-users)

questions.domain: Manage the Microsoft Power Platform environment
questions.question:
Your coworkers build Power Apps and Power Automate flows to improve business processes.  
  
You need to stop your coworkers from using the YouTube connector in the company tenant.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
A Power Platform data loss prevention policy can control connector access at the tenant or environment scope. Placing the YouTube connector in the **Blocked** group prevents makers from using it in Power Apps and Power Automate flows.\
\
**Learn more:** [Data policies - Power Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/wp-data-loss-prevention)

questions.question:
A company currently relies on a manual process to manage escalations for customer-support calls.  
  
You must use Power Automate to automate the process of routing escalated calls.  
  
You need to create the flow.  
  
Which type of connector should be used?
questions.explanation:
The Office 365 Users connector can retrieve organizational user information, including a specified user’s manager profile. This enables a flow to determine the appropriate recipient and route an escalated call accordingly.\
\
**Learn more:** [Office 365 Users connector](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/connectors/office365users/)

options.text: Navigate to the Power Automate admin center and view the projects.
Navigate to the Action Items section of the Power Automate portal.
Enable Repair Tips for the flow.
Navigate to the flow and view the run history.
Navigate to the Power Automate web portal and click view notifications.

questions.explanation:
Power Automate can provide failure details through Repair Tips, failure notifications in the portal, and the flow run history. Repair Tips provide actionable feedback for certain failures, while run history exposes the failed run, failing action, and error details. The Action Items area is used for approvals rather than diagnosing cloud-flow failures.

**Learn more:** [Troubleshoot a cloud flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/fix-flow-failures) · [Understand flow failure notifications in Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/understand-flow-failure-notifications)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
questions.question:
A company operates an online store that sells toys. The volume of order-tracking requests has risen.  
  
You need to let customers use an interactive interface on the website to request order-tracking information. Which technology should you use?
questions.explanation:
Copilot Studio copilots provide customer-facing conversational agents that can be published to a live website. They support self-service customer interactions and can be extended with data sources and actions to retrieve order-tracking details.\
\
**Learn more:** [Agents for customer engagement and handoff - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/customer-copilot-overview) · [Publish an agent to a live or demo website - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ie/microsoft-copilot-studio/publication-connect-bot-to-web-channels)

/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company currently does not keep testing, development, and production separate according to standard Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) protocol. The company uses Power Apps for accounting and sales processes.  
  
The company must use only one login account per user. It must also prevent development and testing from affecting production.  
  
You need to implement a solution that meets the requirements.  
  
Which method should you choose?
questions.explanation:
Separate Power Platform environments provide isolated development, test, and production areas within one Microsoft Entra tenant, so users can retain a single login while changes are developed and tested without affecting production. Microsoft recommends separate development and production environments and at least one additional test environment for healthy ALM.

**Learn more:** [Environment strategy for ALM](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/alm/environment-strategy-alm) · [Power Platform environments overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/environments-overview)

questions.question:
A company uses Power Automate to automate business processes.  
  
You need a flow to run when a user selects a button in an app. Which trigger type should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
The **Power Apps** trigger lets a canvas app control, such as a button, invoke a Power Automate flow. Microsoft Learn specifies that flows run from Power Apps should use the Power Apps trigger.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a canvas app that can trigger a Power Automate flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/how-to/trigger-flow) · [Triggers - Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/triggers-introduction)

questions.question:
A company uses Microsoft 365 and Power Platform, and you do not assign permissions to any licensed users.  
  
Users can create and edit Power Apps canvas apps.  
  
In which environment are the users creating and editing the apps?
questions.explanation:
Licensed users are automatically assigned the Environment Maker role in the tenant’s default environment, which permits them to create and edit canvas apps without individual permission assignments. The default environment is a production environment.\
\
**Learn more:** [Power Platform environments overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/environments-overview)

questions.domain: Manage the Microsoft Power Platform environment
questions.explanation:
The Environment Maker role only lets a user create resources such as apps, connections, and flows within an environment—it does not grant any access to the underlying data. To let a user actually read and interact with records in Dataverse, you must also assign a data-access role. The Common Data Service User (Dataverse User) predefined security role provides baseline read/write privileges to common Dataverse tables and to records the user owns, which is what's required for the developer to access company data through the app. System Customizer is intended for customizing the system (entities, forms, etc.), and Delegate is unrelated to data access—it lets a user run flows on behalf of another user.

**Learn more:** [Security roles and privileges - Power Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/security-roles-privileges) · [Predefined security roles - Power Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/database-security#predefined-security-roles)

A company is assessing ways it can implement AI Builder.  
  
For which two scenarios can AI Builder be used? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Send emails to all users who subscribe to a service.
Synchronize data from an external database.
Collect data from several data sources and display a dashboard that shows trending data.

Detect patterns in data and predict outcomes.

You are building a canvas app.  
  
The app must show a list of records from a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet that is stored in Microsoft OneDrive. An app user must be able to update the item details and save them back to the spreadsheet, or use a button to email the item details to themselves.  
  
You need to determine how many connectors are needed to complete the app.  
  
How many connectors should you use?
questions.explanation:
A OneDrive cloud-storage connection can expose an Excel table in a OneDrive-hosted workbook for the app to read and update. Emailing the item details requires a separate Office 365 Outlook connector. The app therefore needs two connectors.

**Learn more:** [Connect to cloud-storage from Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/connections/cloud-storage-blob-connections) · [Add data connections to canvas apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/add-data-connection)

You are building a canvas app that uses a single connector.  
  
Which two objects does the connector provide? Each correct answer represents a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A connector used in a canvas app can provide data tables, actions, or both. Tables expose data to the app, while actions let the app perform operations. Triggers are not connector objects used by canvas apps in this context.\
\
**Learn more:** [Overview of connectors for canvas apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/connections-list)

The customer service application must be replaced with a model-driven application. The company uses Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages to transfer data from the on-premises database system to a third-party enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.  
  
You need to replace the SSIS packages for data transfer.  
  
What should the company use instead of the packages to move the data?
questions.explanation:
Power Platform connectors let Power Automate and other Power Platform services connect to external data sources and services through available actions and triggers, making them suitable for transferring data between the cloud solution and a third-party ERP system. The Data Migration Framework is intended for managing data entities and data packages in finance and operations apps, not generic third-party ERP integration. [Connectors overview | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/connectors/overview)

The sales team stores quotes as PDF files in a Microsoft OneDrive folder. You create a Microsoft SharePoint list to help the sales team track quote follow-ups.  
  
You need to extract the customer name, phone number, and potential-sale amount from each sales quote and add the data to the SharePoint list.  
  
Which AI Builder model should you use?
questions.explanation:
AI Builder text recognition uses OCR to extract printed or handwritten text from PDF documents and images. The extracted quote text can be used to obtain the customer name, phone number, and potential-sale amount for insertion into SharePoint.

**Learn more:** [Use the text recognition prebuilt model in Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ai-builder/flow-text-recognition) · [Text recognition prebuilt AI model](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ai-builder/prebuilt-text-recognition)

Which two design workspaces can you use? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.

A company uses Power Automate.  
  
Which three items can initiate flows? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Common Data Service (now Microsoft Dataverse) provides triggers such as when a row is added, modified, or deleted. Office 365 Outlook provides triggers for events such as a new email or calendar-event changes. Power Automate for desktop can run desktop flows through Windows sources, including desktop shortcuts, URLs, and Windows Task Scheduler.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Dataverse connector triggers](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/connectors/commondataserviceforapps/) · [Office 365 Outlook connector triggers](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/connectors/office365/)

A company records raw-material quality each day in a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet.  
  
The company’s chief technology officer (CTO) wants to use a model-driven app to capture this information.  
  
The chief executive officer (CEO) will fund development of the app for the CTO only if the CEO understands the advantages of using a model-driven app.  
  
You need to identify the benefits of model-driven apps.  
  
Which two benefits of using a model-driven app should you identify? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: The app contains prebuilt tables, forms, and views that reduce development time.
Users may use the same app on a mobile device, a tablet or a PC.
The app may continue to use the existing Excel spreadsheet as a source of data.
Both staff members and anonymous users may use the app.

questions.explanation:
Model-driven apps use Dataverse tables and provide standard table components, including default forms and views, which support rapid component-focused, low-code development. They also automatically provide a responsive user interface across devices, including mobile devices. A model-driven app requires Dataverse rather than retaining an Excel spreadsheet as its data source, and it is intended for authenticated organizational users rather than anonymous users.

**Learn more:** [Overview of building a model-driven app with Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/model-driven-app-overview) · [Overview of creating apps in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/)

questions.question:
You create dashboards and reports for a project team that combine data from multiple sources in Power BI. Some data is sensitive.  
  
You need to securely distribute the dashboards and reports to the team.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
A published Power BI app packages dashboards and reports for distribution to specific users or groups, with audience-based access controls. A workspace is the collaboration and staging location used to build the content and publish the app.\
\
**Learn more:** [Publish an app in Power BI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/collaborate-share/service-create-distribute-apps)

questions.domain: Manage the Microsoft Power Platform environment
questions.question:
You create a canvas app that enables contractors to submit time worked against a project.  
  
Contractors must be able to use the canvas app to enter time, but they must not be able to perform any other actions in the app.  
  
You need to configure permissions for the contractors.  
  
Which type of permissions should you use?
questions.explanation: Task-level permissions restrict users to specific actions within an application, such as entering time, while preventing access to other app actions.

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
questions.question:
A company has a website that includes a form for collecting information about leads.  
  
You need to configure an automated workflow that creates leads in Dynamics 365 Sales when leads are submitted through the company’s custom website.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
A Power Automate flow can automate an external website submission and use the Microsoft Dataverse connector to create a new row in the Lead table used by Dynamics 365 Sales. Microsoft documents that the connector provides actions to create data in Dataverse.\
\
**Learn more:** [Overview of how to integrate flows with Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/dataverse/overview)

questions.question:
A company has a website that includes a form for collecting information about leads.  
  
You need to configure an automated workflow that creates leads in Dynamics 365 Sales when leads are submitted through the company’s custom website.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
AI Builder models can be consumed in canvas apps, enabling an app-based solution that acts on classified feedback. Power Automate can use AI Builder capabilities in automated flows and branch on negative-feedback results to create engineering-review work and schedule worker training. The Common Data Model defines standardized data structures, while a virtual agent is primarily a conversational interface; neither alone provides the required proactive operational workflow.

**Learn more:** [Use AI Builder models in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ai-builder/powerfx-in-powerapps) · [Licensing and Copilot Credits for AI Builder](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ai-builder/message-management)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Apps
questions.question:
You are building a canvas app that uses one connector.  
  
Which two objects does the connector provide? Each correct answer represents a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A Power Apps canvas-app connector can provide tables of data, actions, or both. Tables expose data for the app to use, while actions expose connector operations. Microsoft Learn documents these as the two object types a connector can provide.\
\
**Learn more:** [Overview of connectors for canvas apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/connections-list)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Pages
questions.question:
A company uses Power Automate.  
  
Whenever a work order is created, a service manager must review and approve that work order before a worker is dispatched.  
  
You need to create a flow that enforces this process.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
An approval flow can start when a work order is created, send an approval request to the service manager, and wait for the approval outcome before continuing to the worker-dispatch step. Microsoft documents the **Start and wait for an approval** action for approval workflows, including work orders.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and test an approval workflow with Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/modern-approvals)

questions.domain: Demonstrate the capabilities of Power Automate
questions.question:
You are building a canvas app.  
  
You choose the app’s form factor.  
  
You need to add a data source.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Canvas apps use connectors to connect to and add data sources, such as Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL Server, or other services.\
\
**Learn more:** [Connect to data in a canvas app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/add-data-connection)

questions.question:
You are building a canvas app.  
  
You choose the app’s form factor.  
  
You need to add a data source.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Power BI can connect to Excel workbooks and to Microsoft Dataverse. Excel is a supported file data source, and Dataverse is a supported Power Platform data source. Microsoft OneNote and Microsoft Word are not native Power BI data sources for creating reports and dashboards.

**Learn more:** [Data sources in Power BI Desktop](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/connect-data/desktop-data-sources) · [Get data from Excel workbook files](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/connect-data/service-excel-workbook-files)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A manufacturing company receives daily shipments that may arrive at any time during the day.  
  
A mailroom manager signs for a shipment, then emails the receptionist from Microsoft Outlook when the shipment is available. The receptionist sends a text message to each driver to notify them that the items in the shipment are ready for delivery.  
  
The company builds a Microsoft Power Automate flow that automatically sends text messages to all drivers as soon as the receptionist receives the email.  
  
You need to identify the component that enables the Power Automate flow to start without intervention from the receptionist.  
  
Which component should you select?

options.text: You do not need to manually back up data.
Both will use the same time zone.

You need to share the Power BI dashboard with coworkers and enable those coworkers to collaborate.  
  
What are two possible ways to accomplish this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create a Power BI workspace and grant coworkers permissions.
Publish the dashboard as an app to your coworkers.
Export the data to Microsoft Excel. Make required changes and then re-import the data.

questions.explanation:
Power BI workspaces are shared environments in which coworkers can be assigned roles to view, edit, and manage Power BI content collaboratively. Exporting data or moving it to SQL Server does not provide sharing or collaboration for the dashboard itself.

What is the minimum number of controls required to implement the interface?

options.text: One control: an edit form control
Two controls: an edit form control and a button control
Three controls: a text input control, a date picker control, and a combo box control
Four controls: a text input control, a date picker control, a combo box control, and a button control

questions.explanation:
An Edit form control can present the fields for a new record through its data cards. A separate Button control can invoke `SubmitForm` to save the form to the data source; when the form is in New mode, a successful submission creates a record. The form’s field inputs do not need to be implemented as separate top-level controls.
